background: Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets is the non-ring-fenced bank of Lloyds Banking Group, housing its markets business, its Crown Dependency banking and lending to larger corporates outside the ring-fence, funded by corporate deposits and wholesale markets.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest at A, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Leverage of 7.6% and LCR of 173% are both in the top quarter of UK majors, while CET1 of 13.5% sits a little below the peer median. The weak spot is direction rather than level: NSFR has fallen 11 points since 30 Jun 2024 to 134%, still above the median, and leverage has fallen 0.4 points since 30 Sep 2025. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
